audio.lint_unbalanced_brackets: An audio tag is not closed.

audio.help_intro: Everything you need for a good take: writing the script, directing the voice, and generating without wasting your quota.
audio.help_speakers: In dialogue, start every line with Speaker 1: or Speaker 2:. Real names stay out of the script sent to the model.
audio.help_tags: Place bracketed tags ideally at the start of a line or sentence. The list below shows proven examples, but other tags (e.g. [confused], [laughing softly]) are accepted too.
audio.help_stage: Avoid stage directions in the script. Prepare for audio converts them, moves them to Direction, or removes them.
audio.help_direction: Put setting, character state, and non-spoken actions in Direction, not in the text to read.
audio.help_dictation: Timed-pause dictation arrives in a future version. In the meantime, insert manual [pause] tags where needed.
audio.console_failed_hint: This take failed - trying again costs you nothing.
audio.player_block_hint: Click a waveform block to regenerate only that part.
audio.param_help_level: Only changes the delivery: speed, pauses, articulation (A1 very slow and crisp, C1 authentic pace with linking). Never rewrites your text.
audio.param_help_pace: The overall tempo of the voice. Combines with Level, which controls articulation and linking.
audio.param_help_accent: The variety you hear (British, Canadian...). The text is still read in the script's language.
audio.param_help_accent_detail: Describe the accent freely: it fully replaces the preset. E.g. "Marseille accent", "German accent".
audio.param_help_style: The overall character of the voice, from tested presets. For a specific trait, add it in Manner of speaking.
audio.param_help_notes: Your free note to the voice actor: hesitations, emotion, confidence... Passed on as written.
audio.param_help_scene: The situation: place, moment, relationship. Sets the overall tone; never read aloud.
audio.guide_direction_1: Level or Pace? Pace sets the overall tempo; Level adapts the articulation: the lower it is, the slower, clearer, and less linked the reading. The text is never modified.
audio.guide_direction_2: Style or Manner of speaking? Style picks a tested character (examiner, host...). Manner of speaking adds your free notes: hesitates, almost whispers, very confident.
audio.guide_direction_3: Accent: pick a preset, or describe it freely in "Custom accent" — the free text then fully replaces the preset.
audio.guide_direction_4: In dialogue mode, each speaker has their own accent, style, and manner of speaking — useful for a native/learner pair or two different registers.
audio.guide_generation_1: Every take is generated directly at final quality: what you hear is exactly what your learners will hear.
audio.guide_generation_2: The estimate comes from the word count; your quota is charged on the actual generated duration, shown afterwards in the player (Estimated · actual).
audio.guide_generation_3: A long take is generated in blocks. In the player, click a block to regenerate only that one — only that block is charged.
audio.guide_generation_4: Audio files expire after 7 days; the script and settings stay in the history — "Duplicate" reloads them in one click.

transcription.diarization_unavailable_body: You asked to tell the speakers apart, but this audio went through the fast engine, which cannot do that. Run it again with “Yes, separate the voices” to get the speaker turns.

transcription.uncertain_summary_one: One uncertain word: it is underlined in the text — read it again before reusing it.
transcription.title: Transcribe an audio
transcription.intro: Paste a podcast link or drop in a file: you get back a timecoded text, ready to read, copy and reuse in class.
transcription.locked: The Transcription workshop is for people enrolled in the course.
transcription.source_placeholder: https://… direct link, RSS feed, episode page or Apple Podcasts
transcription.source_hint: Accepted links: a direct audio file, an RSS feed, an episode page, Apple Podcasts, YouTube. Accepted files: MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, up to 64 MB. Either way, 90 minutes at most.
transcription.speakers_question: Should we tell the speakers apart?
transcription.speakers_on_help: For an interview or a dialogue: each turn is attributed to a voice.
transcription.speakers_off_help: Faster, and enough for a monologue or a recorded lesson.
transcription.language_hint: Only worth setting if the detection gets it wrong.
transcription.quota_empty: You have used all your transcription hours this month.
transcription.status_hint_queued: Your request is saved. Processing starts in a few seconds.
transcription.status_hint_resolving: We are following the link to the audio file. On a podcast feed this sometimes takes ten seconds or so.
transcription.status_hint_transcribing: The audio is being transcribed. Expect about one minute of processing for ten minutes of listening.
transcription.status_hint_completed: It is ready. You can read, copy and download the text.
transcription.episodes_intro: This link leads to a podcast. Pick the episode you want transcribed.
transcription.episodes_none: No episodes were found in this feed.
transcription.error_title: We could not transcribe this audio
transcription.error_unsupported_source: We cannot use this link. Paste a direct audio file, an RSS feed, an episode page or an Apple Podcasts link — or simply drop in the file.
transcription.error_youtube_not_yet_supported: YouTube transcription is not available right now. Try again a little later — or drop in the audio track directly, the transcription works exactly the same.
transcription.error_youtube_unavailable: This YouTube video cannot be reached: it may be private, deleted, or restricted to certain countries. Check the link, or pick another video.
transcription.error_youtube_blocked: YouTube would not let us fetch this video this time. It is nothing on your side: try again in a few minutes.
transcription.error_spotify_not_supported: Spotify does not let anything outside it reach the audio file. Look for the same episode on the podcast's own site or in its RSS feed.
transcription.error_source_unreachable: The link did not answer. Check that it opens in a browser, then try again.
transcription.error_no_audio_found: We opened the page, but there was no audio file attached to it.
transcription.error_source_too_long: This audio runs {{duration}}. The limit is {{max}} — trim it and transcribe the passage you need first.
transcription.error_source_too_long_link: This audio runs {{duration}}, and the limit is {{max}}. It is hosted elsewhere, so you cannot trim it here: pick a shorter episode, or download it and upload an extract.
transcription.error_source_too_large: This file is {{size}}, and the limit is {{max}}. Paste the direct link to the audio instead, or upload a shorter extract.
transcription.error_unsupported_media_type: We do not recognise this format as audio.
transcription.error_provider_unavailable: The transcription service cannot be reached right now. Try again in a few minutes.
transcription.error_provider_failed: The transcription stopped partway through. Start it again — that is usually enough.
transcription.error_quota_exceeded: You have {{remaining}} of transcription left this month, which is not enough for this audio.
transcription.error_internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
transcription.error_rate_limited: That is a lot of feed lookups in a row. Wait a minute, then try again.
transcription.error_generic: The connection failed. Check your network, then try again.
transcription.library_intro: Everything you have transcribed, newest first.
transcription.demo_notice: Demo preview: this text is a sample shipped with the app. No transcription was started.
transcription.player_hint: Click a timecode to hear that passage.
transcription.player_unavailable: The original audio is no longer available: the text is still complete, but there is nothing left to listen back to.
transcription.source_ok_direct_url: This link points to an audio file. You can start the transcription.
transcription.source_ok_podcast: This link points to a podcast: you will pick the episode next.
transcription.limits_help_body: The 90-minute limit applies to a link exactly as it does to a file. A file uploaded here can also be up to 64 MB: pasting the direct link to the audio sends nothing from your computer, so size stops mattering — but the 90 minutes still do. Above that, trim your recording and transcribe just the extract you need, or pick a shorter episode.
transcription.limit_file_too_large: This file is {{size}}, and the limit is {{max}}. Paste the direct link to the audio instead, or upload a shorter extract.
transcription.limit_file_too_long: This recording is {{duration}} long, and the limit is {{max}} per file. Trim it and transcribe the passage you need first.
transcription.retention_notice: Transcripts stay available for {{days}} days, then they are deleted. That is deliberate: a recording of your learners should not sit on our servers indefinitely. Download the text — it is yours.
transcription.retention_nudge: Do download the text before then: after that, the transcription has to be run again.
transcription.retention_nudge_urgent: Nearly out of time: download the text now, or you will have to run the transcription again and it will use your hours a second time.
transcription.expired_body: It was more than {{days}} days old. The text is no longer available to download, but you can run the transcription again from the same audio.
